title: Security Posture Probe report, schemaVersion v0
description: The published contract for the posture probe's report (TM-0882). Versioning: within v0 fields are only ADDED, never removed, renamed, retyped or repurposed, and enum values are only added; anything else is a new schemaVersion (v1) published as a new file beside this one. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know. Gate contract (the process exit code AND summary.gateExit, always equal): 0 clean, no drift and every declared row observed; 1 could not run, an error or any declared row with no usable observation; 2 drift, at least one row with bucket drift. unintended-deny rows are reported and do not set the exit code in v0.

notObserved.description: namespace/job pairs whose collector produced no usable report; every intent row they owned is bucket unknown.

presetRowsDropped.description: Preset intent rows not measured because they name a namespace, target or identity this install does not measure.

notSettled.description: namespace/job -> why that collector could not settle (its pod was never seen policed: a control never read what it must, or readings kept changing). Its rows are bucket unknown.

namespaces.description: Per-namespace black-box detail. Secret NAMES only, never values. Blocks may be absent when a collector shed them to fit its termination message.

baselineFindings.description: Reserved: third-party scanner findings folded into the report. Not produced in v0.

config.description: White-box verdict from the declared NetworkPolicies; 'oracle' for RBAC rows, where the API server is both config and enforcer.

configWhy.description: Which policy decided the config verdict; notes CNI-dependent ipBlock matches.

cause.description: Drift rows only. config: the policy never expressed the intent. enforcement: the policy denies it and the cluster allowed it.

raw.description: Raw connect result (open, refused, timeout, dns-fail) or 'oracle'.

tier.description: Intent tier carried from the intent file (claimed, aspirational).

basis.description: Why the intent exists, carried from the intent file.

gateExit.description: 0 clean, 1 could not run (error or unobserved rows), 2 drift.

unknownCount.description: Declared rows with no usable observation; any makes gateExit 1 (could not run).

schema.description: Which published schema this report was written against. Added within v0; older v0 reports omit it.
